## Overview

This presentation introduces an interactive Shiny application designed to explore global COVID-19 trends.

Data were taken from WHO Statistical Release, which can be accessed here: <https://data.who.int/dashboards/covid19/data>

### Features

- Cumulative cases and deaths visualization
- Country and WHO region filtering
- Time-based analysis
- Interactive Plotly graphs

## How to Use

- Select time range using date filter
- Switch between Country and WHO Region view
- View cumulative cases and deaths
- Interactive tooltips using Plotly
- Customize plot appearance (titles, axes)

### RPubs Shiny App

The Shiny App can be accessed here: <https://ryd8803.shinyapps.io/COVID19_Dashboard_DataReport/>

GitHub can be accessed here: <https://github.com/RYD8803/coviddatadashboard>

```{r, warning = FALSE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, eval = FALSE, results = 'hide'}
url <- "https://srhdpeuwpubsa.blob.core.windows.net/whdh/COVID/WHO-COVID-19-global-daily-data.csv"

download.file(url, destfile = "coviddata.csv", method = "curl")
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, eval = TRUE, results = 'hide'}
coviddata <- read.csv("coviddata.csv", header = TRUE)
head(coviddata)
tail(coviddata)
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, eval = TRUE, results = 'hide'}
#cleaning the data
coviddata$Country <- replace(coviddata$Country, coviddata$Country == "Cura�ao", "Curaçao")

head(coviddata)
```

## Example Usage

We want to plot the number of cumulative cases for Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore in 2020 - 2022

Start date = 2020-01-04

End date = 2022-12-31

```{r, warning = FALSE, eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE}
library(plotly)
country_select <- c("Indonesia", "Malaysia", "Singapore")
date_range <- c("2020-01-04", "2022-12-31")

#Filter the date and country
datacountry <- coviddata[coviddata$Country %in% country_select, ]
data <- datacountry[datacountry$Date_reported >= date_range[1] & datacountry$Date_reported <= date_range[2], ]

#Plot with plot_ly            
p <- plot_ly(data, x = ~Date_reported, y = ~Cumulative_cases, mode = "lines+markers", type = "scatter", color = ~Country, 
        text = ~paste("Country:", Country, "(", Country_code, ")", "<br>WHO Region:", WHO_region, 
        "<br>New cases:", New_cases, "<br>Cumulative cases:", Cumulative_cases), hoverinfo = "text")

p
```

## Plot

```{r, warning = FALSE, eval = TRUE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(plotly)
country_select <- c("Indonesia", "Malaysia", "Singapore")
date_range <- c("2020-01-04", "2022-12-31")

datacountry <- coviddata[coviddata$Country %in% country_select, ]
data <- datacountry[datacountry$Date_reported >= date_range[1] & datacountry$Date_reported <= date_range[2], ]
            
p <- plot_ly(data, x = ~Date_reported, y = ~Cumulative_cases, mode = "lines+markers", type = "scatter", color = ~Country, 
        text = ~paste("Country:", Country, "(", Country_code, ")", "<br>WHO Region:", WHO_region, 
        "<br>New cases:", New_cases, "<br>Cumulative cases:", Cumulative_cases), hoverinfo = "text")

p
```
